entries.title: Airborne Kingdom

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Airborne Kingdom launched first on Windows/macOS, later came to Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox, and the current Steam PC release includes previously released DLC content such as New Game Plus and Hard Mode. Windows PC is the best primary route for highest fidelity and complete current content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam or Epic Games Store.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition/Soundtrack content is not a gameplay remaster. Previously released DLC content includes New Game Plus and Hard Mode.

entries.title: Airborne Empire

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Airborne Empire had its full release on April 17, 2026 after Early Access, with Windows and macOS system requirements. Windows PC is the best primary route because it is the highest-fidelity desktop target with the broadest conventional PC hardware support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition bundle adds soundtrack/booklet/theme extras, not separate gameplay content.
